task: single-leg step: unload, lift, advance, replace

what_changes.reason: at 300 ticks the best leg (LF) ends with its pads already back on the ground (final padz -0.0048, criterion <= 0.004) but carrying only 0.036 body weight against the required 0.10, i.e. the episode ends while the weight is still transferring. Extending the time budget tests whether the behaviour completes; it does not relax any threshold.

acceptance_criteria_unchanged.unload: min load over the episode <= 0.10 body weight
acceptance_criteria_unchanged.place: at the last tick load >= 0.10 body weight AND pad bottom height <= 0.004
acceptance_criteria_unchanged.pass_rate: a leg passes only if all five hold; six-leg pass requires all six

unchanged_elsewhere.reward: achievement-flag potential (PREREG_AMENDMENT_3.json) plus unchanged safety penalties
unchanged_elsewhere.warm_start: screened lift direction of the prompted leg while it carries load
unchanged_elsewhere.world: derived triad body, releasable adhesion, own commands only

preregistered_outcomes: if a leg passes at 500 ticks but not at 300, the behaviour is real but slower than the first window, which is a rate statement and must be reported as such
if no leg passes at 500 ticks, the placement criterion is not a timing artefact and the next step is the two-phase weight-shift task for the hind legs
if a leg passes only after more than 24 updates, the optimisation budget, not the task, was binding
discipline: PREREG.json, PREREG_AMENDMENT_1/2/3.json are left byte-identical; the 300-tick results stay valid and are kept as the v1 record
